title: Video by kallaway
description:
ChatGPT can now automatically edit your videos with GPT-6 Astra.

And if you make video content of any kind, the people that learn how to use this are going to have a massive advantage. 

What you’re watching is GPT-6 Astra in Codex…controlling Davinci Resolve using an MCP.

In layman’s terms…

ChatGPT can now control your timeline for you.

It can make cuts, delete bad takes, find b-roll, add text and graphics, design animations, and mix the sound…all automatically.

All you have to do, as the human, is creative direct by talking.

Now as a creator, and someone who used to spend 8 hours per video editing, this is one of the wildest things I’ve ever seen.

It literally feels like self-editing alien technology has just been given to the content world.

And this works for short-form video, long-form video, 3D animations in Blender, motion graphics in After Effects.

It’s pretty wild.

Now I’ll be the first to admit…the edits and workflow are not yet perfect.

It’d be tough to make a video like this one automatically without any mistakes.

But this feels like a seminal moment.

We have now broken the 4 minute mile for automated video editing.

And so in just a few years, most of the editing workflow will be programmable and directable.

Now all of this is only possible because of GPT-6 Astra.

OpenAI has essentially crossed the threshold into the early stages of what feels like AGI.

So if you make content, I really recommend trying this out because this will only get better and better over time.

Shoutout all of the amazing creators that have been testing this!

Follow @kallaway to learn more about tech & AI
